entities.name: UE initiated detach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to detach from network, either due to switch off or normal detach. Involves sending DETACH REQUEST message and handling different detach types.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate detach procedure. Contains Detach type IE and EPS mobile identity IE.

entities.name: Detach type
entities.description: IE indicating whether detach is due to switch off and whether detach is for EPS services only, non-EPS services only, or both.

entities.name: EPS mobile identity
entities.description: IE containing GUTI, IMSI, or IMEI depending on UE's available identities.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity used to identify UE in EPS.

entities.name: IMSI
entities.description: International Mobile Subscriber Identity, permanent subscriber identifier.

entities.name: IMEI
entities.description: International Mobile Equipment Identity, device hardware identifier.

entities.name: T3421
entities.description: Timer started in UE after sending DETACH REQUEST when detach is not due to switch off and UE is in EMM-REGISTERED or EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: EMM state where UE has initiated registration but not yet completed.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: EMM state entered when UE initiates detach for EPS services.

entities.name: MM IMSI DETACH PENDING
entities.description: MM state entered when detach type indicates detach for non-EPS services or both EPS and non-EPS services.

entities.name: Detach due to switch off
entities.description: Condition where UE is detaching because it is being switched off.

entities.name: EPS security context storage
entities.description: UE stores current EPS security context as valid after sending last DETACH REQUEST message.

relations.description: UE initiated detach procedure involves sending DETACH REQUEST message.
DETACH REQUEST message contains Detach type IE.
DETACH REQUEST message contains EPS mobile identity IE.
EPS mobile identity IE contains GUTI if UE has valid GUTI.
EPS mobile identity IE contains IMSI if UE has no valid GUTI.
EPS mobile identity IE contains IMEI if UE has neither valid GUTI nor valid IMSI.
Procedure starts timer T3421 when detach is not due to switch off and UE is in EMM-REGISTERED or EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.
Procedure establishes EMM-DEREGISTERED-INITIATED state when detach type indicates detach for EPS services.
Procedure establishes MM IMSI DETACH PENDING state when detach type indicates detach for non-EPS services or both.
Procedure establishes EPS security context storage after last DETACH REQUEST is sent.
Procedure behavior depends on whether detach is due to switch off.
Procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state for certain behaviors.
Procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state for certain behaviors.
